subject: adding the value of a second factor to facet labels

messages.author: 028f6dd03e1f43b1
messages.subject: adding the value of a second factor to facet labels
parts:
I have a complicated facet grid that, at least for exploratory purposes, it makes sense to order the 31 facets by the criterion score (“crit.sc”). However, it also makes sense, for ease of identification, to add the subject identification number (“sid”) to each facet.

Somehow this seems like a problem that someone else should have had already but none of my google searches have found a method of doing this — other than annotating each facet by hand. Does anyone know of any way to add the factor level for the “sid” for each facet?

In summary, there are 31 criterion scores. Each one is unique to one of the 31 sids. I would like to have the facets ordered by the criterion score (which the code below does quite nicely) but also “annotated” by the SID label.

ggplot(data=ct.byGame, aes(x=game.rank, y=num.fixs.byGame, fill=crit.sc)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity") +
# facet_wrap(sid ~ .)
facet_wrap( ~ crit.sc, ncol=4)

Thanks

Wayne

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: adding the value of a second factor to facet labels
parts:
In the absence of a reproducible example, I'll attempt to provide a
general suggestion:

1. Create a factor version of your faceting variable, and set its
levels to the ordering you want.
2. In the same definition of (1), assign the SID values as labels for
the factor.

See ?factor for further details if necessary.

Then use the created factor as the variable in facet_wrap(). The strip
labels for the facets will then be the SID labels.

HTH,
Dennis

Hi Wayne,

 

It would be good to have the data, but I assume the following will serve your needs:

ggplot(data=ct.byGame, aes(x=game.rank, y=num.fixs.byGame, fill=crit.sc)) +

    geom_bar(stat="identity") +
facet_wrap( ~ crit.sc + sid, ncol=4)
